scope: DeGram milestone critique against original ptBIM paper, ITcon submission, public literature and current source; not product implementation

findings.original_proposal: Desktop harness and corporate graph intermediary
findings.recommendation: Communication/integration application consuming DG semantics, not sixth graph or replacement reasoning core
findings.acceptance: Another user reconstructs an accepted decision from project artifacts without chat access

findings.recommendation: Versioned organizational vocabulary package with steward approval and project pin; migration contract owned jointly with v11, never drop project filters
findings.acceptance: Shared term update preserves historical runs and private project boundaries

findings.paper: P p8 §3.2; T p13 bridges and p20 §4
findings.recommendation: Approved source fragment/version and concise decision rationale in SpecGraph/Session; local transcript not authoritative
findings.acceptance: Rule provenance survives source re-ingest and a new user's session

findings.recommendation: Typed domain lifecycle, atomic revision/CAS, retirement of referenced artifacts instead of destructive updates
findings.acceptance: Concurrent edits conflict; prior accepted result retains reconstructible rule

findings.recommendation: Object-centered trace queries, exact atom/edge order and explicit coverage; no bulk graph dump into LLM
findings.acceptance: Absent or truncated context is disclosed; answers cite source/rule/object/state

findings.recommendation: Reuse full ui-v2 surface securely, add trace and freshness context; resolve scoped Speckle access
findings.acceptance: Web parity plus correct project/revision links and no cross-project model access

findings.recommendation: Per-PC local adapters and HTTP-backed DG repositories, user-delegated auth, explicit document targeting
findings.acceptance: Two PCs control only their selected CAD documents and use no shared service token

findings.paper: P p7 §3.1; T p8 CQ3 boundary
findings.recommendation: Intent-based patches to reference-definition component set with diff/undo/solve/readback; solver remains GH/Kangaroo
findings.acceptance: Actual geometry/topology and unaffected objects verified independently of tool-call status

findings.recommendation: Bind exact atom/property to parameter identity and measurement semantics; distinguish control input from derived quantity
findings.acceptance: Duplicate names and multi-property rules neither guess nor over-bind

findings.recommendation: Real document-scoped mapping, typed units/source ownership and bounded property handover; no claim of lossless IFC or universal sync
findings.acceptance: Same conceptual object retains distinguishable native measurements and conflicts

findings.recommendation: Separate capture identity, content comparison and task/alternative comparability; repair only required producer/read seams
findings.acceptance: Two definitions cannot overwrite candidate attribution; changed criteria not mistaken for improved design

findings.recommendation: Canonical statuses plus applicability/input/population coverage and independent solver-derived measurements
findings.acceptance: Empty or missing inputs cannot yield full design compliance

findings.recommendation: Reference/import document revision and source fragment; updates create proposals, not automatic ontology rewrites
findings.acceptance: New brief version produces bounded impact list without retroactively altering accepted records

findings.recommendation: One local agent plus authoritative server domain workflows; existing compiler reused; user inference gateway separate from internal /llm/generate
findings.acceptance: No duplicated rule compiler or corporate secrets in client; added agent roles require comparative evidence

findings.paper: P p7 primary decision-maker; T p20 confirm/publish
findings.recommendation: One meaningful change proposal, distinguish permission/commit/validation/design acceptance; no imaginary cross-CAD-and-DB atomicity
findings.acceptance: Local apply with failed publish is visible pending-publication and retry is idempotent

findings.recommendation: Absorb v9.1 interface into DeGram; transfer CKBS/BWRT/SEDT outcomes and chosen CONS; minimum publish revisions in v13, full WPER history in v10
findings.acceptance: Each requirement has one owner and no superseded item marked completed

findings.recommendation: v12 closure plus selective v11 shared-contract decisions before dependent v13 writes; not whole manuscript milestone as blocker
findings.acceptance: Pinned runtime vocabulary/profile and one canonical outcome vocabulary

findings.paper: P p6 §2.5, p8 Table1, T p11 §2.4 and p26 evaluation priorities
findings.recommendation: Compare current DG web+addin to DeGram and optionally typed-command ablation; measure total human effort, correctness, trace retention and handover
findings.acceptance: Benefit assessed against predeclared baseline/margins; no inferred savings from paper's informal metrics
